source.license: Open data (CKAN; license field empty — confirm exact terms)

mapping_rules.company_id: Use Subjekt.ico; LEFT-PAD to 8 digits before joining with ARES.
mapping_rules.company_type: Use Udaj[PRAVNI_FORMA].pravniForma.nazev (also encoded in the package name).
mapping_rules.activity: Use Udaj[PREDMET_PODNIKANI]/[PREDMET_CINNOSTI] (free text; take NACE codes from ARES).
mapping_rules.officers: Use Udaj[STATUTARNI_ORGAN_CLEN] + [DOZORCI_RADA_CLEN] osoba — PERSONAL DATA incl. DOB (GDPR).
mapping_rules.owners: Use Udaj[AKCIONAR] (a.s.) / [SPOLECNIK] (s.r.o.) — may be personal data (GDPR).
mapping_rules.status: Derive from presence of LIKVIDATOR / INSOLVENCE and (via ARES) datumZaniku.

fixture_requirements: active a.s. with board, supervisory board, share capital, shareholder (e.g. CR Holding a.s.)
officer record with date of birth (PII) to exercise redaction/retention handling

live_test_plan.smoke: package_show for one {form}-actual-{court}-{year}; download its .xml.gz with redirect-following (-L) and stream-parse the first few <Subjekt> elements.
live_test_plan.full: Enumerate all {form}-actual-{court}-{year} packages and stream-parse behind env gates; preserve raw gzip snapshots.

blockers: CKAN package license field empty — confirm exact reuse terms with the Ministry of Justice before redistribution.
File URLs 302-redirect — the HTTP client must follow redirects.
Officer/shareholder records contain date of birth — GDPR personal data; lawful basis + retention required.
